full_judgment: 23. Doctrine of reasonableness is based upon a rationale which cannot be undermined by avoiding responsibility entrusted with the respondents. All these days the petitioners were moving from pillar to post to settle their reasonable and legitimate expectations that they would be absorbed in the revenue budget of the Dhaka City Corporation failing which they have come before this Court.
